claims.head: Watch Carolina’s puck management
claims.call: At least its usual 7.9% of Philadelphia’s 5-on-5 chances come right after winning the puck.
claims.body: Carolina gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (25th of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). Philadelphia ranks 2nd for chances off turnovers.

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Expect Carolina to fire from everywhere
claims.call: Carolina takes at least its usual 61.0 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.body: Carolina ranks 6th of 32 for shot volume (61.0 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Philadelphia ranks 27th for shot suppression.

claims.head: Two of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams
claims.call: The two teams’ combined hit score reaches their usual 119.
claims.body: Carolina’s hit score is 128 (2nd of 32) and Philadelphia’s is 110 (7th). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.

check.rule: held if tonight's combined hit score is at or above the two teams' average; partly if above 100; otherwise didn't happen

faceoff.text: J. Staal is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 71% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 24 seconds at a time, against 63 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by N. Ehlers (8 of 10 changes).

PHI.head: Philadelphia starts a half-step ahead
PHI.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Carolina is playing for the second night in a row, and Philadelphia has home ice. Not by much, though: Carolina can make it interesting if it keeps shots to a minimum.

CAR.head: A slightly uphill night for Carolina
CAR.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Carolina is playing for the second night in a row, and Philadelphia has home ice. Carolina’s best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.
